name: send_money — amount > every account, fall back to ask_amount with no_funds_anywhere

steps._comment: ₹95,000 exceeds every account (savings 18.5k, current 60k, wallet 2.3k). switch_source_account returns empty, on_empty_goto sends user back to ask_amount with the no_funds_anywhere message.
User retries with a feasible amount — flows directly to CONFIRM (savings has 18,500, 200 fits).
